message: The other night, we had a surprise power outage during dinner. Instead of scrambling around in the dark, I remembered I had charged my power bank earlier that day. I quickly grabbed it and powered up my phone, which allowed us to enjoy our meal by the light of a trusty flashlight. It felt like a small win, but it made the evening feel cozy and fun instead of chaotic. Sometimes, a little preparedness can turn a potential mess into a memorable night. Have you had a little win like that?
